protocol.e2eDefinition: Measured wall time around the whole per-frame pipeline on the analyzer thread: YUV->RGB conversion, letterbox, inference, decode and NMS. Excludes overlay drawing and PNG encoding. T_e2e = T_pre + T_infer + T_post + T_overhead holds by construction; overhead is reported, not dropped.
protocol.statistics: Computed after the run from every recorded frame past the warm-up. SD is the sample SD (n-1). P95 is the nearest-rank percentile on the sorted sample (no interpolation).
protocol.scope: Preliminary on-device deployment validation. One camera run over one target cluster; frames are not independent samples and no detection-accuracy metric is derived from them.
